messages:
Carla (Partner): hi team — partner ready to run a co-sell POC next week. they need a clear tech onboarding checklist, an enterprise quote for private deployment, and answers to a short security questionnaire. can we map owners?
Ben (Sales): thanks. short list from partner: 1) pricing for a 2-week reserved tiny cluster, 2) confirm SSO options + required artifacts, 3) subprocessor list + auditor access note.
Alice (Prod Eng): on SSO: we support SAML and OIDC. for SAML we need the IdP metadata XML, ACS URL, and the NameID format they expect. also will need SP metadata from us.
Derek (Solutions): perf note: expecting ~40 concurrent sessions, avg seq length ~400. recommend 3xA40 equivalent for the trial to keep p95 < 300ms with a 20ms batching window.
Carla (Partner): they also insist on IP allowlisting and cert rotation policy. can we provide exact CIDRs and cert rollover cadence?
Alice (Prod Eng): yes. provide CIDRs for peering: 10.18.0.0/16 (example), plus ephemeral egress ranges 3.0.0.0/16 for model hub fetches. cert rotation: we rotate TLS certs every 90 days by default; we support customer-managed keys via KMS/HSM for disk encryption and signing.
legal@redwood: subprocessors list is maintained by Legal — we can provide the current list and a template MAA. audit access requires a scoped request and NDA amendment in many cases.
Carla (Partner): their security team sent a short questionnaire (attached). key asks: data residency, retention windows, encryption at rest/in transit, and ability to delete data on request.
compliance-bot: quick pointers: TLS1.2+, AES-256 at rest, default request log retention 30 days (configurable). SOC2 + ISO docs: https://redwood.example.com/compliance.
Ben (Sales): pricing question: do we have a minimum commit for Reserved for channel-co-sell? and can we give a reduced min for partner-led pilots?
Derek (Solutions): partner deals: typical min commit is 1 month, but we can do a prorated 2-week reserved trial for channel partners with finance approval. I'll draft two options: prorated 2-week trial vs standard 1mo minimum.
Alice (Prod Eng): onboarding runbook draft (for infra team):
1) Exchange SAML metadata + IP CIDRs
2) Provision VPC peering / PrivateLink or install on-prem package
3) Provide POC API key & verify curl smoke test
4) Run perf smoke (p50/p95) for 24-48h
5) Capture telemetry & iterate

Sample smoke test (share with their infra):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example.com/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED_POC_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"test"}'
```
Carla (Partner): need an explicit network checklist — partner infra won't accept vague ranges. please include exact port numbers and CIDRs.
Alice (Prod Eng): will post a one-page checklist: ports: 443 (API), 50051 (gRPC gateway, if used), 10250 (kube api for on-prem ops), ephemeral high ports 30000-32767 for nodeport traffic. CIDRs: primary peering 10.18.0.0/16, backup region 10.19.0.0/16. exact egress for model hub: 3.0.0.0/16.
Carla (Partner): legal blocker: they want subprocessors and a sample MAA before sharing host-level logs. can we get that fast?
legal@redwood: acknowledged — will send trimmed subprocessors list and sample MAA within 48h. audit requests require a scoped process; we'll note that in the questionnaire response.
Ben (Sales): next actions: Derek to send a preliminary quote by EOD (placeholder numbers ok), Alice to post the network checklist + SAML attribute list by tomorrow AM, legal to provide subprocessors list. Partner to provide IdP metadata + infra contact within 48h.
Derek (Solutions): quote approach: two lines — infra-only reserved rate + managed platform fee. include prorated option for <=30 days. will tag finance.
Carla (Partner): timeline: partner requests kickoff next Tue (6 days). is that feasible?
Alice (Prod Eng): feasible if we get SAML metadata and IP contacts in 48h and sign MAA redline for logs (if needed). we can spin up the trial cluster within 48h of approvals.
compliance-bot: note: retention can be shortened to contractual terms; deletion requests supported but may require coordination with support.
Carla (Partner): last Q — can you give a single POC tech contact (email + slack) so partner PM has one thread?
Alice (Prod Eng): I'll be the tech POC: alice@redwood.example.com, Slack: @alice. Derek is solutions POC for config + pricing. Ben is commercial POC.
Ben (Sales): good sync. looping finance + legal. I'll update partner after Derek's quote.
Carla (Partner): thanks everyone. will follow up once we have the IdP metadata. :thumbsup:
